notes: All 37 source morphemes and 45 target tokens are partitioned exactly once.
The explicit `אָנֹכִי` keeps only its own *I* while the copula joins the predicate `רֹאֶה` (rule 20).
`שָׁלַח` → *I will let ... go* is rule 44's light verb and complement, headed on *go* and discontinuous around the object pronoun.
The waw of `וַאֲכַלְתֶּם` takes the *for* the ASV wrote for it (rule 14's open list), and `הַיּוֹם` fuses to *to day* (rule 30).
